title: spiranthes gracilis var. brevilabris
intro: Spiranthes gracilis var. brevilabris, commonly known as the short-labellied ladies' tresses, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions attributed to Spiranthes gracilis var. brevilabris include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, although further research is needed to confirm the exact composition and effects of these compounds.
